## Problem

What pain does this address? "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed solution

How should this work? Be specific — describe the user-facing behavior, not
just the code change.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you consider? Why is the proposed solution better?

## Scope

- [ ] Affects the bash side (`bin/tmux-sessionizer`)
- [ ] Affects the nvim plugin (`nvim-plugin/`)
- [ ] Affects the contract (pin file format, session naming, picker markers)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Tests only

If the contract changes, please open a discussion first — both sides need to
move together.
